title: How to review pet profile every week
description: Reviewing a pet profile every week, with entries stored on your device and a way back to normal after a day has been missed.
answer: Three people in the family chat ask about pet profile, and none of the answers match. PetGo keeps pet profile on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.
PetGo keeps pet profile on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.
If you miss several days, do not wipe history. Open the last entry, fill in one day, then close.

table.caption: A working frame for pet profile

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open PetGo when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Can I open pet profile offline?
Yes. PetGo keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
